cc:Work.dc:title: Collarbone avatar for Clavicle773 without the number, two color treatments

svg.title: Collarbone avatar for Clavicle773 without the number, two color treatments
svg.desc: Two large circular avatars on black with a pair of collarbones and a dark gray ring. Variant A has red collarbones. Variant B has light gray collarbones with red knobbed ends.
